answer: Each identity must lock 200 POA for 20 epochs before attesting, forfeiting it if peers prove duplicate work. The bond climbs a steep ridge: a second locks 400, a third 800, doubling thereafter, so ten fakes cost 204,600 instead of 2,000, each with its own 20-epoch wait. Verification has three rounds: peers re-run sampled work, confirm the stake receipt on-ledger, and compare output hashes, with a zephyr-light random audit adding extra cases each epoch. Identities passing all rounds keep rewards; a violet flag on mismatched stakes or hashes freezes payouts pending review.
